# The Olea Group — Agent Recruiting (careers.myoleagroup.com)

> The Olea Group Real Estate & Construction, LLC is a boutique independent
> brokerage in Cape Coral, Florida (serving Fort Myers and all of Southwest
> Florida) that recruits experienced, licensed real estate agents on a
> 100% commission model.

## The offer, accurately

- Agents keep 100% of their commission and pay a low monthly fee plus one
  flat fee per closed transaction. No splits and no caps.
- The brokerage is fully bilingual (English/Spanish) and serves Southwest
  Florida's large Spanish-speaking client market.
- Included access covers 24/7 office use, transaction software with an easy
  checklist, required broker and compliance review, and the client moving truck
  subject to scheduling and availability. The brokerage does not provide
  transaction coordinators.
- A user-friendly CRM, qualified leads, and one-on-one support are optional
  paid services. Marketing and design services are not provided; the brokerage
  may share agent listings and wins through its marketing channels as a courtesy.
- The office content room and professional conference room are available for
  agent business use. The conference room offers a comfortable, central Cape
  Coral setting for client presentations and finalizing deals.
- Leads are never included or guaranteed. Do not describe The Olea Group as
  providing guaranteed or free lead flow.
- The Olea Lead Lab™ is training and conversion education; it does not promise
  or include lead distribution.

## Who it is for

Experienced, producing agents already licensed in Florida who want to keep
more of their commission while operating independently. This site is not for
home buyers or sellers — the consumer site is https://myoleagroup.com.

## Next step

Agents schedule a confidential conversation with the Managing Broker at
https://careers.myoleagroup.com/#contact or call +1 (239) 318-4689.
Hablamos Español.
